text:
jess: Ok team — RC build rc-2026-04-e84 is ready for origination. Requesting pin and QA hold. @qa-lead can you confirm smoke harness?

sam: grabbing the artifact now, will pin in the registry. sending pin shortly.

andre: noted. we should enable the traffic-shim feature-flag for gradual ramp. also want an automated rollback callback if 5xx rate > 0.8% for 3 consecutive minutes.

qa-lead: smoke started, running the basic prompt-suite and kv-warm check. ETA ~8m. will post results.

deploy-bot: [info] pin request received: artifact=rc-2026-04-e84 registry=dedicated-pool-1
deploy-bot: [info] pin successful -> pinned_tag=prod-pin-rc-2026-04-e84

sam: pin done. command used:
```
registryctl pin --artifact rc-2026-04-e84 --env prod --tag prod-pin-rc-2026-04-e84
```

jess: thanks. schedule: canary traffic 5% for 15m -> 25% for 20m -> 100% if healthy. keep KV warmers on the canary nodes.

andre: adding staged flag: `enable_rc_2026_04_e84_shim` on prod. I'll open the rollout with 5% ramp. Also wiring the rollback callback to ops playbook endpoint /api/v1/ops/rollback-callback.

jess: @sheriff-oncall you'll own the first 30m. If the rollback callback fires, assume automatic scale-down and then manual hold. We'll run the post-canary evals listed in the checklist.

sheriff-oncall: ack. I have runbooks open. quick checklist:
- watch p95 latency and 5xxs
- watch error-logging spike rate
- validate model outputs on sample corpus
- be ready to pin traffic back to previous tag: prod-pin-rc-2026-04-e83

qa-lead: smoke passed. kv-warm ok. sample outputs look fine. marking QA hold release-ready. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [action] initiating canary promotion steps
- create canary deployment (5%)
- enable feature-flag enable_rc_2026_04_e84_shim on 5% cohort
- start telemetry alarms for rollback callback

deploy-bot: [info] canary deployment created: cohort=canary-42 nodes=18 traffic=5%

andre: ramp job started. hooking the callback: payload sample -> `{"signal":"ROLLBACK","reason":"5xx_rate","metrics":{"5xx_rate":0.009}}`

sam: throwing a quick smoke load: `wrk -c200 -t8 -d120s https://api.prod.redwood.ai/generate` to validate steady-state.

jess: stream logs to #eng-oncall and paste any anomalies here. Also note the canary has cache-warm TTL=10m so expect slight token throughput variance.

deploy-bot: [alarm] metric watch: 5xx_rate=0.002 (threshold=0.008) — within bounds

deploy-bot: [info] canary 5% healthy after 10m, proceeding to 25% ramp window 20m

andre: 25% ramping now, enabling additional batching configs on canary nodes to match prod profile.

sheriff-oncall: monitoring, no spike on errors, latency stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [info] promotion to 100% scheduled after 20m unless rollback callback triggers

jess: if anything looks off during the 25% window call it immediately. Otherwise we'll promote to full at 09:40 UTC.

deploy-bot: [info] promotion complete -> traffic=100% tag=prod-pin-rc-2026-04-e84

sam: post-promote checks running: hit the health endpoints, run surface-level prompts, verify embeddings job.

qa-lead: running smoke again post-promo. all green so far.

sheriff-oncall: no rollback events. closing watch at +45m. leaving note in release doc.

jess: excellent run. ETA to finalize release notes and close RC: 30m. I'll draft the release blurb and QA signoff in the release doc. :tada:

andre: adding automated rollback callback artifact to the runbook for future RCs.

deploy-bot: [info] release metadata -> rc=rc-2026-04-e84 promoted_by=jess promotion_ts=1789998950

jess: thread complete — thanks everyone!
